scope: Offline audit of the working tree on 2026-11-18, including the existing unreleased parser changes. Examples measure search and eligibility decisions. Provider responses are controlled fixtures; the results do not measure live availability, installed application behavior, population frequency or stream continuity.

postFixReplay.additionalExploratoryPairs: The larger replay also changes some dashes inside full upload captions or nested annotations. Ten such transformations still require more evidence or conflict. These include moving the title into parentheses after the performer, which changes the caption structure.

delimiterExperiment.source: 286-row local catalog snapshot. Take titles containing a spaced dash and an edition-like final label; exclude comma-separated artist strings. The reported subset uses unique artist/title pairs with a final label under 100 characters containing no brackets or parentheses and ending in mix, version, edit, remix or remaster, or equal to live, edit, remix or remastered.
delimiterExperiment.method: A Spotify-shaped request and a synthetic structured YouTube Topic candidate with the same artist and controlled duration (200 s), no shared recording ID. Compare the unchanged title first, then wrap only the final dash label in parentheses on the candidate. Both variants use the same candidate channel and artist fields. All 100 controls accepted in Balanced and Flexible. The alternate forms returned the same action in both modes.

additionalReproductions.input: Don't Think Twice, It's All Right / Dont Think Twice, Its All Right; 光 / 光【官方MV】; Lumière / Lumière (Clip officiel); Song / Song (Official Audio); Song / Song Official Audio
additionalReproductions.observed: The YouTube Music locator title filter discarded all five. Passing the corresponding structured audio metadata to the resolved matcher accepted all five. An alternate search path may still find the recording.
additionalReproductions.fix: Use a shared title comparison for retrieval and preserve the complete candidate for verification.

additionalReproductions.input: Identical Signal (Live) (Acoustic), or identical Signal (Ava Remix) (Radio Edit), same performer and runtime
additionalReproductions.observed: Both sides flagged as having conflicting versions. Exact and Flexible ask for more evidence after resolution on YouTube and Monochrome fixtures. Live plus a dated remaster is a passing control.
additionalReproductions.fix: Compare timing/edit, arrangement, performance, remixer, venue and mastering where explicitly present. Multiple compatible labels may describe one recording. Keep distinct venues or remixers as conflicts.

additionalReproductions.input: Lead, Ava, Bea / Lead for Signal (Ava Remix)
additionalReproductions.observed: Exact accepted a candidate missing Bea. Reordering the request to Lead, Bea, Ava prevented acceptance. Av also matched part of Ava.
additionalReproductions.fix: Remove the substring-and-truncate branch. Reuse the existing per-credit exact remixer-name exclusion. Require evidence for all other performers.

additionalReproductions.input: Sonata in F♯ minor / Sonata in F minor; Concerto in B♭ major / Concerto in B major
additionalReproductions.observed: Balanced and Flexible accepted both pairs as exact with matching runtimes. F♯ minor versus F-sharp minor was rejected. Symbol-only identical titles can also yield an empty identity.
additionalReproductions.fix: Keep a conservative recording-identity key separate from a loose search key. Canonicalize adjacent musical accidentals in musical-key context. Preserve distinct literal symbols on structured titles.

additionalReproductions.input: Various compilation with two parent suites credited to different quartets, each with a child titled Allegro
additionalReproductions.observed: Both rows inherited Various. Each row retained its parent title but lost the parent performer.
additionalReproductions.fix: Prefer child performer credits, then the nearest explicit parent performing credit, then the release. Carry the work title as scoped query context.

additionalReproductions.input: Title 4:33, dedicated duration 4:54; alternatively title runs 4: and 33
additionalReproductions.observed: Single-run title supplied the wrong 273-second duration. Multi-run title was truncated to 4:. Normal title control yielded 294 seconds.
additionalReproductions.fix: Assemble all title runs. Prefer the duration field, then a validated duration from the appropriate metadata column.

additionalReproductions.input: Add Live at Wembley next month — tickets on sale now! to an otherwise accepted studio fixture
additionalReproductions.observed: Balanced rejected with versionConflict. Recorded live at Wembley. also rejected, correctly.
additionalReproductions.fix: Use explicit recording-specific attribution as version evidence. Treat promotional venue mentions as weak context.

additionalReproductions.input: !!!, Pardon My Freedom, even with a structured performer credit
additionalReproductions.observed: Search plan had zero queries. A spelled-out artist control generated a query.
additionalReproductions.fix: Preserve nonempty symbolic names from explicit artist fields or provider identities and require literal or verified identity agreement.

additionalReproductions.input: Catalog recording titled Unknown with a known performer
additionalReproductions.observed: The catalog placeholder predicate blocks resolution before selected source inspection. The matching candidate is eligible if passed separately to the verifier.
additionalReproductions.fix: Use missing-data or non-audio provenance to block placeholders. Respect a verified recording or an explicitly selected audio source.

additionalReproductions.input: Unstructured Aya x Bea versus separate structured performer credits Aya and Bea
additionalReproductions.observed: Both provider fixtures rejected. A comma-separated control worked.
additionalReproductions.fix: Interpret an ambiguous join only when separate structured credits corroborate both names, while preserving a literal band name.

additionalReproductions.input: Track followed by nonbreaking spaces around a dash and Radio Edit versus Track (Radio Edit); Don＇t Go versus Don't Go
additionalReproductions.observed: Matched controls using ordinary spaces or ASCII apostrophes accepted; the variants rejected.
additionalReproductions.fix: Normalize delimiter whitespace and supported apostrophe variants consistently before classification, keeping original strings and byte spans.

unknownDurationControl.mode: Flexible, Allow matches without a known length enabled, known candidate duration
unknownDurationControl.result: Matching unmodified Bongo Bong - Live accepted as probable with no request duration. The alternative delimiter was rejected with or without duration and identified title/version conflicts, not a missing-length restriction.

qualificationPlan: Replay raw provider rows through ingestion, query planning, locator retention and resolved verification. Capture the first stage that dropped the source and why. Keep explicitly selected provider IDs on their dedicated path.

For each positive control, add a near miss for wrong key, performer, remixer, live venue or movement. Run matching cases across supported modes and repeat with unknown duration on and off. Keep this targeted set separate from a held-out evaluation set.

Once offline fixtures pass, repeat representative album, radio-save, playlist and explicitly selected upload examples through the packaged player. Record selected versus resolved media ID, first audio, and completion versus transport failure.
